description: What Jev answered about each line of one choice point now (4, third rule): sent when a line is queued, answered, or fails, and when the settings change which boxes are checked.

choicePoint.description: The choice point the lines are in.

day.description: The journal day the choice point is kept with.

lines.description: Every non-empty line of every box that has an evaluator, box by box.

items.description: One non-empty line of a checked box, in the box's order.

field.description: The box the line is in.

status.description: pending: waiting for Jev. done: answered. failed: Jev could not be asked; error says why.

answers.description: Jev's answers to every question of the box's evaluator; empty until done.

items.description: Jev's answer to one question about the line.

option.description: An answer of the question: the id of a pick question's option, or yes or no for a yes / no question.

name.description: The answer as the user sees it: the option's name, or Yes or No.

p.description: How likely Jev holds the answer to be.

error.description: Why the last check failed, as llm: decide said it; left out when nothing failed.
